abstract.p: The present invention pertains to a method for manufacturing a ready-to-use peptide emulsion on the industrial scale, comprising the step of emulsifying a suspension of at least two peptides under low shear conditions with at least one adjuvant.It is also directed to a ready-to-use emulsion obtainable according to this method.This invention allows the delivery of a scalable emulsion of peptides which preserves their integrity and fulfills the requirements needed for a pharmaceutical sterile product.
